_readme: Which skills ship in which pack. scripts/build_hub.py builds every zip from skills/. Pack version = newest skill Version line in it. Change 'note' when you ship a change: it goes in the update notice.

packs.title: Jarvis 2.0 core
packs.note: Module 1 to 7 naming everywhere, Module 4 opens once your offer is approved, update link support.

packs.title: Agency HQ app (your HUD)
packs.note: Phone layout, Connections screen, Set up my voice.

packs.title: Module 2: The Irresistible Offer
packs.note: Six line offer with your guarantee.

packs.title: Module 3: Funnels
packs.note: Landing page with palettes and SMS consent.

packs.title: Module 4: Outreach
packs.note: Drafts wait until your booking page works, then send through the safety check.

packs.title: Module 5: Paid Ads
packs.note: Ad scripts, image ads and Meta setup. Ad editing coming soon.

packs.title: Module 6: Sales
packs.note: Call brief, solution design and the one page proposal.

packs.title: Module 7: Fulfilment
packs.note: One build plan a developer or Jarvis can build from.

packs.title: Websites pack
packs.note: Research, brand directions and premium sites for you, your prospects and your clients.
